title: Block Editor (Gutenberg) Troubleshooting
description: Fix editor not loading, missing blocks, REST API failures, reusable blocks issues, and classic editor conflicts.

steps.title: Identify Editor Symptom
steps.instructions: Note if the editor white-screens, blocks fail to insert, styles are wrong in editor vs front end, or only certain post types are affected.

steps.title: Verify REST API and Permalinks
steps.instructions: Block editor depends on /wp-json/. Test REST in browser or Site Health. Flush permalinks and fix security plugins blocking REST for logged-in users.

steps.title: Check Browser Console for Block Errors
steps.instructions: Open DevTools when loading the editor. Failed block registrations, React errors, or 404 script loads often point to a specific plugin block.

steps.title: Isolate Plugin Block Conflicts
steps.instructions: Deactivate plugins that register blocks (page builders, ACF blocks, custom blocks) one at a time. Use Health Check troubleshooting mode if needed.

steps.title: Resolve Classic Editor Plugin Conflicts
steps.instructions: Classic Editor, Disable Gutenberg, or builder plugins may force the wrong editor per post type. Review plugin settings and use_block_editor filter conflicts.

steps.title: Audit theme.json and Block Theme Settings
steps.instructions: Block themes use theme.json for colors, fonts, and layout. Invalid JSON or aggressive theme restrictions can hide blocks or break editor styles.

steps.title: Fix Broken Reusable Blocks and Patterns
steps.instructions: Invalid reusable block references show validation errors. Edit or recreate broken reusables. Sync patterns after theme updates if using theme-bundled patterns.

steps.title: Verify Edit, Save, and Front-End Match
steps.instructions: Create a test post with core blocks, save, and compare editor preview to the published page. Test on a second post type if the issue was CPT-specific.
